requirements.label: Introductory Biology Sequence
requirements.hint: Choose Sequence A, B, or C. No optional pass/fail.

requirements.label: Sequence A: BIOLOGY 171, 172 or 174, and 173
requirements.hint: BIOLOGY 171, one of 172 or 174, and the 173 lab. No optional pass/fail.

requirements.label: Sequence B: BIOLOGY 195 (AP) and 173
requirements.hint: AP/IB credit for BIOLOGY 195 plus the BIOLOGY 173 lab. No optional pass/fail.

requirements.label: Sequence C: BIOLOGY 191 (transfer), 192, and 173
requirements.hint: Transfer credit for BIOLOGY 191 plus BIOLOGY 192 (Fall only) and the 173 lab. No optional pass/fail.

requirements.label: Chemistry Sequence
requirements.hint: CHEM 210 and CHEM 211.

requirements.label: Quantitative Analysis Sequence
requirements.hint: 3 courses from the approved list: Calculus I (MATH 115, 120, 185, 275, or 295), Calculus II (MATH 116, 121, 156, 186, 276, or 296), Physics I or II, programming (EECS 183, 203, or 280), statistics (STATS 180, 250, 280, or 400-level and above, min 3 credits), BIOLOGY 202, BIOLOGY 131, COMPFOR 131, BIOPHYS 131, DATASCI 101, BIOPHYS or PHYSICS 290, or EARTH 468. Courses used here cannot double count as major electives.

requirements.label: Group A: Gateway Biology, 2 courses
requirements.hint: Choose 2 of: BIOLOGY 205, 207, 225, 230, 252, 256, 272, 288, or 290. Min 6 credits. Lab courses in this group may also count toward the lab requirement.

requirements.label: Group B: Health and Society, 2 courses
requirements.hint: Choose 2 from the approved Health and Society list, offered across many departments (for example PUBHLTH 200, PHIL 356, ANTHRCUL 344, HISTORY 234, SOC 302, ENVIRON 310, WGS 220). Min 6 credits.

requirements.label: Group C: Core Biology, 2 courses
requirements.hint: Choose 2 courses from two different topics: Genetics (BIOLOGY 305), Biochemistry (MCDB 310, BIOLCHEM 415, or CHEM 351), Ecology (BIOLOGY 281 or 282), Evolution (EEB 390, 391, or 392). Min 6 credits. The two courses must come from different topics.

requirements.label: Group D: Biology Elective, 1 course
requirements.hint: One BIOLOGY, EEB, or MCDB course at the 200, 300, or 400 level. Min 3 credits. A third course from Group A or Group C can be used here. Exclusions apply: BIOLOGY 200, 212, 241, 299, 312; MCDB or EEB 300, 301, 302, 312, 360, 396, 397, 399, 400, 412, 460, 461, 494, 499 do not count.

requirements.label: Lab Requirement
requirements.hint: 1 course from the approved Bio Lab list (for example BIOLOGY 207, 226, 230, 288, MCDB 306, EEB 372, MCDB 423). May overlap with other major requirements. EEB or MCDB 300 or 400 independent research, elected for at least 3 credits in a single term, may also fulfill it.

requirements.label: Major Credits: minimum 24 credits
requirements.hint: Courses from Groups A, B, C, D, the lab list, and approved cognates count. Prerequisites, introductory science courses, and departmental transfer credit are excluded. Max 3 credits of independent research. At least 16 of the 24 credits must be taken in residence. If still short of 24, Group E options can fill in: CHEM 230 and above, MATH or PHYSICS 200-level and above, STATS 250 or 400-level and above (when not used as prerequisites), MICRBIOL 440 or 460.
